sources.title: RFC 7838: HTTP Alternative Services
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: CDNI Metadata：快取規則傳遞與配置差異
related.titleEn: CDNI Metadata: policy propagation and configuration differences
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：只在未到期且origin認證通過時採用；此練習不繞過憑證驗證。 交接時須能核對：交付 alt-svc-cache.csv、origin隔離測試與回退事件圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Use only unexpired origin-authenticated alternatives; this exercise never bypasses certificate verification. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver alt-svc-cache.csv, origin-isolation tests and fallback timelines.
related.difference: 以host、path match、revision、checksum建物件索引，記錄規則繼承及覆寫範圍。
related.differenceEn: Index host, path match, revision and checksum, recording rule inheritance and override scope.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
Alt-Svc宣告替代服務不改變原origin語意；替代端點仍須符合該origin的認證要求。
教學基準：100+600-400 = 300 s remaining；對照：100+600-750 = -50 s remaining。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

CDNI metadata讓內容分發節點交換控制資訊；規則需要按host/path等範圍解讀，不能盲目覆蓋。
教學基準：6*2500/200000*100 = 7.5 %；對照：18*2500/200000*100 = 22.5 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Alt-Svc advertises another service without changing origin semantics; the alternative still needs valid authentication for the origin.
Teaching baseline: 100+600-400 = 300 s remaining; comparison: 100+600-750 = -50 s remaining. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

CDNI metadata exchanges delivery controls; rules are interpreted by host/path scope rather than blindly overwriting configuration.
Teaching baseline: 6*2500/200000*100 = 7.5 %; comparison: 18*2500/200000*100 = 22.5 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: STAMP：序號、重排與丟失估計
related.titleEn: STAMP: sequence numbers, reordering and loss estimation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：只在未到期且origin認證通過時採用；此練習不繞過憑證驗證。 交接時須能核對：交付 alt-svc-cache.csv、origin隔離測試與回退事件圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Use only unexpired origin-authenticated alternatives; this exercise never bypasses certificate verification. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver alt-svc-cache.csv, origin-isolation tests and fallback timelines.
related.difference: 建立session、seq、send time、arrival time，分別統計準時、晚到、重複及未回覆。
related.differenceEn: Record session, sequence and timestamps and separately count timely, late, duplicate and absent replies.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
Alt-Svc宣告替代服務不改變原origin語意；替代端點仍須符合該origin的認證要求。
教學基準：100+600-400 = 300 s remaining；對照：100+600-750 = -50 s remaining。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

STAMP量測需以session及序號關聯；重排和重複回覆不能直接當丟失或額外成功。
教學基準：(100-95)/100*100 = 5 %；對照：(100-98)/100*100 = 2 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Alt-Svc advertises another service without changing origin semantics; the alternative still needs valid authentication for the origin.
Teaching baseline: 100+600-400 = 300 s remaining; comparison: 100+600-750 = -50 s remaining. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

STAMP measurements join by session and sequence; reordered or duplicate replies are not automatically losses or extra successes.
Teaching baseline: (100-95)/100*100 = 5 %; comparison: (100-98)/100*100 = 2 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
